falsifiable_hypothesis: The existing hierarchical refinement is gated only by global vector reliability. A strong fold-wide common contrast can be informative even when global targetwise reliability is more modest. The probabilistic union w=1-(1-a_global)(1-a_common) is parameter-free, equals a_global when common reliability is zero, and increases hierarchical use only when the common mode is independently reliable.
component_rule: Orientation A is leave-one-whole-patient bagged geometry. Orientation B starts from interpolated-jackknife geometry. No A/B prediction averaging occurs.
shrinkage_rule: Using the same three authenticated inner whole-patient bandwidth-0.7 OOF contrast vectors, compute theta_global, theta_hier, a_global and a_common exactly as in reliability_weighted_hierarchical_js. Set w_union=1-(1-a_global)*(1-a_common), then theta=(1-w_union)*theta_global+w_union*theta_hier and q_B=q_B,interpolated_jackknife-0.5*theta. No free weight menu, target/fold outer routing, or protected data is used.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across separately costed A/B orientations; never average predictions
